title: Review and confirm documents
description: Review is where ScanFinder shows anything it wasn't sure about: check the details against the page, fix a value if needed, confirm — and it learns. Assumes documents are waiting in the queue (after the import video).

steps.narration: Review is where ScanFinder shows you anything it wasn't sure about. Most of the time you're just confirming; now and then you fix a value — and every confirmation teaches it a little more.
steps.caption: Review: confirm what it read, fix what it missed

steps.narration: Click Review in the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Review

steps.narration: The queue on the left lists what's waiting for you, grouped by sender. Ironbridge is a supplier ScanFinder has never met, so all five of its invoices are here. Copperfield was taught earlier — it says two more confirmations and that sender will file on its own.
steps.caption: Grouped by sender · new senders need a look

steps.narration: Click a sender to open its documents,
steps.caption: 2. Click a sender

steps.narration: then click one to open it.
steps.caption: 3. Click a document

steps.narration: The page is on the right and the details it read are on the left: the issuer, the date and the reference — the three things that decide where the file goes and what it's called. Anything it's unsure about is highlighted.
steps.caption: Page on the right · details on the left

steps.narration: Compare each detail with the page. If a value is wrong, click in the field and type what's actually printed — ScanFinder remembers the correction for that sender. If it's missing altogether, the little plus button lets you draw a box round it on the page, just like teaching.
steps.caption: Wrong? Type the correction · Missing? ⊕ draw it

steps.narration: When it all matches, click Confirm. The document is filed into its company, year and month folder, and the confirmation counts toward ScanFinder trusting this sender.
steps.caption: 4. Confirm — files it and teaches it

steps.narration: The next document loads straight away, so a queue goes quickly. Once a sender has been confirmed a few times, its documents stop appearing here at all — they file themselves.
steps.caption: A few confirms per sender, then it files itself

steps.narration: And when several documents read cleanly and just need a nod, File all ready files them in one go.
steps.caption: File all ready — one click for the clean ones

steps.narration: That's Review. Next: finding any document in seconds with Search.
steps.caption: Next: Search
